issues.legal_issue: Civil courts cannot entertain a suit concerning land rights where the dispute could or ought to have been adjudicated in consolidation proceedings.
material_facts: The land was in an area covered by a consolidation notification.
A claimant asserted an interest in the land based on family relationship and argued that the recorded holder held it in a representative capacity.
The consolidation authorities adjudicated the competing claims to the land.
A civil suit was later brought seeking a declaration that the consolidation order was without jurisdiction.
issues.conclusion: The suit was barred because the claims concerned rights in land that fell within the adjudicatory functions of the consolidation authorities.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 4(2), 5(2), and 49 of the U.P. Consolidation of Holdings Act, 1953, as amended, assign consolidation authorities the adjudication of rights and interests in land within a notified area, including questions of title that could or ought to be raised in consolidation proceedings, and bar civil or revenue court proceedings on those matters. The Court relied on Ram Adhar Singh v. Ramroop Singh and Gorakh Nath Dube v. Hari Narain Singh. It distinguished Suba Singh v. Mahendra Singh, which concerned a dispute arising after consolidation operations had been completed under the earlier statutory scheme.

rule.if: civil_suit_challenges_consolidation_order and land_is_in_notified_consolidation_area and dispute_concerns_land_rights and dispute_could_or_ought_to_be_adjudicated_in_consolidation_proceedings

predicates.civil_suit_challenges_consolidation_orde: A person brought a civil suit challenging an order made in consolidation proceedings as beyond the authority of the decision-maker.
predicates.land_is_in_notified_consolidation_area: The land at issue lies in an area covered by a notification initiating consolidation proceedings.
predicates.dispute_concerns_land_rights: The dispute concerns a person's rights or interests in land, including a claim based on title, family relationship, or representative ownership.
predicates.dispute_could_or_ought_to_be_adjudicated: The disputed right is one that could or ought to have been raised and adjudicated by the consolidation authorities.

issues.definition: When a civil suit challenges a consolidation order concerning rights in land in a notified area, and the dispute could or ought to have been adjudicated in consolidation proceedings, the civil court lacks jurisdiction to hear it.
